items.title: Brandon Calderon Morales
items.text:
Omaha, Nebraska. English and Spanish. Engineer, Marine veteran.

Video game nerd first, a few wrong directions, then machines: court reporter for the Marines (where the typing speed comes from), React and Java at Leidos, classified SAIC work I can't talk about, now Fiserv.

items.title: The day job
items.text: Technical delivery lead on two efforts. When a vulnerability storm hits, I coordinate 20+ engineering teams and show them how coding agents plus our security stack (Fortify, Wiz, SonarQube) squash findings faster than legacy code ever allowed. The other: observability — one clear portfolio picture, so leadership stops squinting. Alongside: CI/CD for hundreds of repos and a grassroots push to make innovation a habit instead of a slide deck.
